response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack software engineer (15+ years, BS in Computer Science) with strong web, backend, and low-latency service work, but the role requires principal-level hardware architecture expertise that is entirely absent from the resume. There is no evidence of SoC or IP modeling, RTL/architectural simulation, SIMD/MIMD or GPU architecture, deep neural network training/inference optimization, or hardware-software co-design for AI accelerators. The closest adjacent experience — C/C++ work at National Instruments, some embedded exposure, and low-latency D services — is far removed from AI accelerator performance modeling. The mismatch is fundamental rather than a matter of degree, so an interview is not warranted for this specific req.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, teaching and talks
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or performance-simulation experience
No AI accelerator, GPU architecture, or DNN training/inference optimization background
Career trajectory is full-stack/product engineering, not principal-level hardware IC work

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture skills
No AI accelerator / DNN workload optimization experience
Extensive software engineering seniority and systems performance work
